void-black.$description: Void Black — Primary text, headings, and high-contrast body copy across light surfaces

fog-white.$description: Fog White — Page canvas and light section backgrounds

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, modal backgrounds, form inputs on light sections

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, muted labels, icon fills on light surfaces

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, nav punctuation, disabled state text

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, dividers, input outlines, table rules

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle section dividers, link icon backgrounds, hover wash backgrounds

stone.$description: Stone — Placeholder text, code comments, muted helper copy

obsidian-card.$description: Obsidian Card — Dark product demo card backgrounds in mixed-mode sections

dark-surface.$description: Dark Surface — Elevated dark panel backgrounds, code block surfaces

slate-mid.$description: Slate Mid — Mid-tone icon fills and body copy inside dark card contexts

electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Primary CTA button fill, active heading accents — the single chromatic action color; its mid-spectrum violet reads developer-brand without borrowing blue from infrastructure tools; Atmospheric hero background gradient blending violet and yellow; Brand gradient for decorative text highlights and horizontal accent rules

violet-soft.$description: Violet Soft — Decorative list and tag backgrounds, subtle brand surface tints

cyan-spark.$description: Cyan Spark — Heading accent text inside dark sections, code string highlights, decorative icon glow

soehnemono.$description: soehneMono — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

geist.$description: Primary typeface for all marketing copy, UI labels, headings, and CTAs. The custom numeric tables (geistNumbers variant) keep digit spacing consistent inside product demos. Negative tracking at -0.035em at large sizes and -0.015em at mid sizes compresses display headlines into a dense technical block — a deliberate contrast to softer marketing type.

ui-sans-serif.$description: System fallback font used in browser-rendered components, OS UI widgets, and the Clerk-embedded auth modal. Its presence signals authentic native-UI feel in interactive demos.

inter.$description: UI micro-labels, product card annotations, and icon captions within embedded component previews.

shne-mono.$description: Code snippets, JSX component labels (<SignUp />, <UserButton />), and terminal output. The +0.10em positive tracking at mono sizes makes angle-bracket syntax air out instead of colliding — a purposeful readability choice at 10-12px.
